basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in building and upgrading PCs but always try to keep it budget-friendly. I enjoy strategy games and online multiplayer games during my free time. I'm single, and my typical online hours are in the evenings after work. I dislike overpriced tech and waiting for new GPU stocks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design, which introduced me to high-performance computing. I keep myself updated on the latest tech trends through online forums and tech reviews on YouTube. My interest in gaming and personal computing led me to learn about hardware through self-teaching.
